_doc: LANCE-19 batch 3: Utility Truck (RGriffin65) as the ordnance truck; 2 axles, front steers.
notes: Vehicle rework (LANCE-19 batch 3, 2026-10-31), differs from the mech text above: no joints or actuators. The fit is level (`no_icp` in ordnancetruck_veh.json). The kit's fused hull was split by `tools/art/v3/veh_prep.py` (ordnancetruck_prep.json). The wheels (`wheel_l0`..) are OWN GEOMETRY (`make_wheel`: tyre drum, recessed rim, hub boss, bolts) on axles fitted to the kit's wheels, which were cut from the hull; this own geometry is part of the CC BY-SA 4.0 derivative. Welded at 3 mm and planar-dissolved at 3 degrees, collapse only above 80k faces a part (no collapse on the shell-soup Hunter route; these hulls are clean). WHEELED, 2 axles (the original has 4 and two red cargo containers; the kit is a plain utility truck with a flat bed). The front pair is under `steer_l0`/`steer_r0`. Two red cargo containers (LANCE-19, Lee 2026-10-31) are OWN GEOMETRY (`veh_prep.py` `make_container`: a tapering bevelled box with ribs, door-seam bars and corner castings, sized from the 2001 model's containers and set on the kit's bed), static parts of the hull; their colour is fixed red (`fixed_colour` in ordnancetruck.json), not team colour. No turret or gun.
